_meta.no_deed_text: No Deed Book Found or Provided
_meta.deed_formats: Minnesota recorders index by document number (abstract) and certificate of title number (Torrens); old records use book and page. Deed references appear only in county layers, never in the state standard. Field examples are recorded per county in deed_format.
_meta.plat_formats: Plat names are served as text (plat_name / PLAT_NAME / PlatName); recorded in fields.plat_ref where present.
excluded_false_hits: gis.lyonco.org is Lyon County MN (used as alternate for Lyon, not an Iowa layer)
Same-name counties in other states (Cass ND/NE/IA, Dodge WI/NE, Rock WI/NE, Brown WI/SD, Clay IA/SD, Martin FL, Lyon IA) were excluded by sample point and county polygon checks

status_legend.ok: county layer with owner, PIN and a deed document field on at least half the parcels, covering the county
status_legend.partial: owner and PIN but deed field missing or thin (including all statewide-layer counties), or the layer may not cover the whole county
status_legend.missing: no current owner layer with a live public ArcGIS endpoint
